sources.title: LoRA Extraction | arcee-ai/mergekit | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This page documents the mergekit-extract-lora command, which extracts a PEFT-compatible LoRA adapter from the difference between a fine-tuned model and its base model using truncated singular value decomposition (SVD). This tool produces adapters that are directly loadable by the PEFT library.
